description:
[Servers] One server network and its servers. The network's summary (as in `/servers/brands`) plus `server_list`: every member server, online ones first and
busiest first, as `{id, name, country, players, max_players, is_online, connect, vanilla, url}`. Use
`/servers/{id}` for one server in full. Member list cached for five minutes. The network's servers, busiest first. Slugs come from list_server_brands.

slug.description: The brand's slug from `/servers/brands` (the part after /brand/ in its servers.rustprofit.com URL).
